'''Sheard''' was a [[human]] who served as [[station commander]] of [[Station Control West]] onboard the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]]. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]], the crew of the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' set off alarms in [[Detention Block AA-23]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] while trying to [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescue]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] just as Sheard's shift was starting. He and the previous shift commander [[Pamel Poul]] then attempted to discover what was going on in the detention block and listened to [[Ensign]] [[Toos]] speak to the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], who was trying to convince them everything was fine in the block.

==Biography==
===A problematic handover===
{{Quote|Show me the ship, main screen.|Sheard asks to see the ''Millennium Falcon''|<ref name="EOW" />}}
Sheard was a [[human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[station commander]] onboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station]], sharing command of [[Station Control West]] with [[Commander]] [[Pamel Poul]].<ref name="EOW" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> he arrived in the station control room by [[turbolift]] to relieve Poul at the end of her twelve [[Standard hour|hour]] shift. They casually saluted each other, and Poul handed over her [[datapad]] and informed Sheard of the events of her shift, particularly focusing on the arrival of the [[YT-1300 light freighter]]<ref name="EOW" /> known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''<ref name="ANH" /> in [[Docking Bay 327]], which fell under their jurisdiction.<ref name="EOW" /> The [[freighter]] had been pulled into the dock by a [[tractor beam]]<ref name="ANH" /> and was holding up incoming traffic while an inspection team led by [[Captain]]<ref name="EOW" /> [[Edmos Khurgee]]<ref name="Propoganda">''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]''</ref> checked it out.<ref name="EOW" />

Sheard ordered [[Ensign]] [[Toos]] to show him the [[Starship|vessel]] on the main screen and then he, Poul, Toos and [[Sublieutenant]] [[Slallen]] discussed the heavily modified vessel and [[Slallen's brother]]. Just as Poul was about to leave, an alarm began to sound and Toos informed the commanders that all the [[sensor]]s in [[Detention Block AA-23]] had just gone down. Unbeknownst to the occupants of Station Control West,<ref name="EOW" /> the crew of the ''Millennium Falcon'' had taken out the [[scanning crew]] and made their way to the detention block in order to try and [[Rescue of Princess Leia|rescue]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], who was being held in a cell there.<ref name="ANH" />

===A boring conversation===
{{Quote|This is Station Control West, Commander Sheard. This is a priority red request. Put us through to the grand moff immediately.|Sheard|<ref name="EOW" />}}
Poul ordered Toos to open comms, but as the detention block held [[Politics|political]] [[prisoner]]s it had secured comms and so they would have to wait for someone to answer. The [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], captain of the ''Falcon'', answered the comms as he and his allies had already incapacitated the Imperial staff of the detention block. Solo unconvincingly attempted to persuade Toos and the others that everything was fine, but the ensign informed the smuggler that they were sending a [[squad]] to investigate. Solo then claimed there was a [[reactor]] leak in order to try and dissuade them. Sheard asked who was commanding the detention block, and when Poul answered that it should be [[Shann Childsen]], Toos stated that Solo's voice clearly wasn't Childsen's and asked for the smugglers [[operating number]]. Panicking, Solo shot the [[comm unit]] with his [[blaster]] and ended the conversation.<ref name="EOW" />

After Poul had Toos verify that there was no reactor leak she ordered she ordered the ensign to send in a security squad and contact [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]. Tarkin initially was not available, but when Sheard declared it a priority red request the Grand [[Moff]] answered and upon hearing the alert was from Detention Block AA-23 ordered that all sections be put on alert. Sheard invited Poul to remain while the situation played out, but she chose to leave and get some rest.<ref name="EOW" /> The crew of the ''Falcon'' soon managed to escape with the princess on their freighter and returned her to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Great Temple|headquarters]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. The Death Star tracked them there, but was then [[Battle of Yavin|destroyed]] above the moon by the Alliance.<ref name="ANH" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I didn't even know these things were still flying.|Sheard comments on the ''Millennium Falcon''|<ref name="EOW" />}}
Sheard had a thick moustache, and drew a finger along its underside while Poul updated her on the events of her shift. He was surprised to see an YT-1300 still active.<ref name="EOW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sheard first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] albeit unnamed. Sheard was first identified in the short story "[[End of Watch]]," which was written by [[Adam Christopher]] and published in the ''[[From a Certain Point of View]]'' anthology book<ref name="EOW" /> on [[October 3]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/jon-hamm-as-boba-fett-leads-an-all-star-cast-on-the-from-a-certain-point-of-view-audiobook-exclusive|text=''From a Certain Point of View'' Audiobook Exclusive - Jon Hamm (as Boba Fett!) Leads an All-Star Cast}}</ref> Sheard shares his name and thick mustache with actor [[Michael Sheard]], who portrayed [[Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel|Ozzel]] in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
